reviewAuthority: Integrator engineering review of the v1.2 required test denominator

evidence.decisionSummary: Adopt the explicit environment, variant, build-profile and aggregation definitions as the required denominator; retain positive MT targets, real-device and human obligations, unexecuted states and unresolved readiness.
engineeringChecks: 32 focused inventory and existing contract tests

adoptedDenominatorDecisions.acceptedScope: Adopt the explicit candidate definition rows: all five real browser classes for public C/I/A behavior, Node plus Chrome for low-level binding/U fixtures, host-only artifact audits, exact HOST/DEVICE splits, three named product devices for performance, and one separately allocated human cohort. Node is not an AIR main-entry or rendering substitute. Keep all six platform classes and every fixed ID. For fixtures introduced before M5, schedule non-host-browser matrix cells at M5 while retaining the original fixture introduction phase; host Chrome/Node keep the source first phase. All positive MT cells first require M6 or later. This staging recommendation does not certify a complete parent at an earlier checkpoint.

Retain the explicit MT2/MT4 shared-behavior cells and MT3 legal-count cells in the accepted matrix. Real successful pool/world execution is required only for the 1,331 cells with positiveMtExecutionRequired=true. The other 18 MT-related cells are artifact/contract audits or source-required negative diagnostics and cannot establish runtime compatibility. The six positive MT target classes are technically frozen as required obligations; actual support is established only by their corresponding real tests. Missing resources or capability observations cannot automatically replace positive obligations with unsupported/fallback credit. G0 fixture and other readiness conditions remain independently unmet.

Adopt criticalDebugReleaseTestIds exactly as the initial risk-based proposal: ABI, ST isolation, generation, heap growth, binding ownership/snapshot, real binding platform, runtime body setters/damping, contact snapshot/transient sensors/callback destruction, invalid query/setter rollback, complete app close and both real-native U fixtures. Run the entire required fixture in each listed build profile, with separate native artifact identities. Extend through a versioned technical review when risk warrants it.

Keep 91 parent aggregates and 84 fixed references plus U01/U02; only generated executable cells count. A caseKey is an internal fixture unit, not a new acceptance category. Split-only parents aggregate children; additive parents also require a parent-table-remainder caseKey. Build profile and worker count are explicit key dimensions; named performance profile and human cohort are caseKey dimensions. Aggregate fixed WASM-13-AIR-ST and C28-SENSOR-CCD are not executable or double-counted. WASM-15 aggregates P01–P07. Do not merge or remove cells without a reviewed version change and retained prior contract.

unresolvedReadinessDecisions.blocks: G7 performance freeze; profile/MT applicability is separately decided by D01/D02, not by availability of baselines
fixture-ready execution and G0 fixture readiness, not an otherwise defined denominator

revisionPolicy: No in-place edits or automatic regeneration of this v1 review or its frozen denominator. Changed inputs or scope require a new explicitly reviewed version, retaining v1 and its historical inputs.
